name: First Into the Breach
text:
When First Into the Breach enters the battlefield, put a vanguard counter on target creature you control.
Aura, instant, and sorcery spells you cast that target a creature you control with a vanguard counter cost {1} less to cast.
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell that targets only a creature you control with a vanguard counter, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
Whenever a creature you control with a vanguard counter leaves the battlefield, you may put a vanguard counter on another creature you control.
